status: Live-pilot redesign candidate; text-only; no application implementation or validity claim
intro: Imagine yourself as you usually are in situations like these. Tell me what you would probably do, feel, or notice rather than the ideal answer. Conditions that change your answer are useful data. You do not need to invent missing facts: if a premise is too vague, say what is missing. You can change a scene that does not fit, skip a question, or stop. A remembered example is welcome, not required.
planning_rule: Routes are opportunities, not quotas. Ask only when one concrete unresolved distinction remains useful, the premise supplies the facts needed to answer it, and the answer is not already present or recoverable from the respondent's prior words. Context dependence is evidence; do not force a global trait.

questions.interpretation_limit: Optional alternative to inferring novelty preference from a disappointing cancellation; record the particular comparison, not a global trait. The answer supports only what it says; the prompt never fills a response field.
questions.context_requirement: Self-contained starting scene or report cue; no prior participant answer is required. Apply usefulness, applicability, privacy and pause rules. Any topic-related context links are advisory, not prerequisites.

questions.question: Apart from losing the things you already said help closeness, is there anything else that would usually make you feel less close over time?
questions.context_binding_rule: Bind to the indicated scene and actual answer, not the last utterance by position.
questions.admission: INTERVIEW-PROTOCOL-v6.md global admission AND: The chosen romantic context remains applicable/welcome; a genuinely additional weakening pathway is still useful and unanswered after reading G13 and R05. Skip if the only likely answer is the ordinary inverse of already named closeness conditions.
questions.interpretation_limit: Retain only genuinely additional weakening dimensions. Mirrored opposites of earlier positive conditions are not independent evidence.
questions.context_requirement: one actual matching antecedent; a claimed comparison requires both scoped answers

routing_guards.premise_sufficiency: Before asking, verify that motive, baseline, cause, workload/intensity, environmental conditions, relationship frame, and other answer-determining facts are supplied when material. If the respondent would have to invent the main determinant, repair or replace the scene first.
routing_guards.construct_discrimination: Suppress questions whose ordinary answer is nearly forced or tautological. A question must permit materially different plausible answers that would change the scoped description.
routing_guards.redundancy: Read the full prior answer set. Do not ask a positive/negative mirror, paraphrase, or field-filling follow-up when the distinction is already supplied. Inverse wording is not independent evidence.
routing_guards.missing_piece: When a response supplies some useful parts but one target remains missing, acknowledge what was supplied and ask only the missing piece. Do not replay the whole scene unless referential repair requires it.
routing_guards.context_dependence: When the respondent says 'it depends', retain the named conditions. Ask a narrower contrast only if it can change the description; never force one global default.
routing_guards.admission_stop: Unknown, declined, inapplicable, already-answered, or antecedent-missing routes are closed for the moment. Stop when no useful admissible distinction remains.

pilot_lineage.privacy: Raw participant answers are not part of this artifact.

exploratory_questions.question: You walk into a room that smells normal to you. A friend you generally trust says, “This smells moldy.” You still cannot smell anything unusual. What would you do next?
exploratory_questions.admission: Ask only in a separately labeled exploratory block after canonical interviewing is complete or naturally stopped. Never use it to fill a canonical AstroHD facet, planning target, stopping decision, or evidence credit until a separate mapping review authorizes one.
exploratory_questions.interpretation_limit: Retain only the rule for resolving this specific cross-person sensory disagreement. Do not infer objective mold, superior perception, gullibility, health anxiety, or population rarity.

planner_output_rule: Planner or selector output is proposal-only. Before rendering any exact question, including generated narrow follow-ups, re-run context binding, premise sufficiency, construct discrimination, nonredundancy, construct alignment, single-response-task, and expected-information-gain checks on the exact user-facing wording. Expected information gain means plausible answers are likely to resolve or materially change the scoped description, not merely restate an obvious feasibility condition, add a weak preference, or make the description slightly nicer. Reject or repair any wording that fails; if repair still fails, leave the facet unresolved rather than asking a weak question.
